description: This Java source file defines the 'SecuredFreemarker' class, which contains methods to prevent Freemarker template injection and sanitization within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides security checks for input strings and HTTP requests/response interactions involving Freemarker templates.

classes.name: SecuredFreemarker
classes.description: A utility class providing security measures against Freemarker template injection by inspecting and sanitizing input parameters and HTTP request data.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Checks if a given string contains Freemarker interpolation patterns or if an HTTP request/URI contains such patterns, likely indicating an injection attempt.

methods.name: containsFreemarkerInterpolation
methods.description: Checks if a string contains Freemarker interpolation sequences and logs an error, sending a HTTP 403 error response if true.

methods.name: sanitizeParameterMap
methods.description: Sanitizes input parameters by replacing Freemarker interpolation sequences with a placeholder to prevent exploitation.
